title: Olivier salad
description: A classic Russian potato salad commonly served during festive occasions.
instructions: Chop the potatoes and carrots into small pieces.
Try to cut all the ingredients into similar sizes for even mixing and better presentation.
Boil the potatoes and carrots until tender for about 10-15 minutes after bringing to a boil.
At the same time, boil the eggs for 10 minutes after bringing to a boil until hard-boiled.
In a large bowl, mix the boiled vegetables with peas, chopped eggs, pickles/cucumbers and your choice of meat.
Add the mayonnaise, salt, and black pepper to the mixture and stir until well combined.
Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before serving.
